data.title: 春原瞬 · 庭院廊下的落肩毛衣小憩
data.description: 午后微风吹拂的梅花园庭院木廊，竹影斑驳摇曳。瞬脱去繁重教服，身穿宽松轻软的浅米色落肩针织开衫，领口微垂露出优雅纤秀的颈项与锁骨。她侧卧在长木椅软垫上，怀中抱着温热的瓷茶壶，呼吸匀长平静，虎耳微微耸动，展现出卸下育幼重担后的极致惬意。
data.location: peaceful shaded wooden veranda overlooking bamboo courtyard pond
data.action: lounging on wooden veranda bench with off-shoulder cardigan, holding warm teapot, breeze fluttering hair, serene relaxed expression looking at viewer
data.lighting: soft dappled sunlight through bamboo leaves creating peaceful patterns
data.mood: peaceful afternoon serenity, tender maternal tranquility
data.promptProse: Reclining on a shaded garden veranda with bamboo rustling in the breeze, Shun wears a cozy off-shoulder cardigan. Dappled afternoon sunbeams dance across her bare collarbone as she smiles with gentle, sleepy warmth.
data.animaCaption: Shun lounging on a wooden veranda in an off-shoulder cardigan, smiling in dappled sunlight.
